headline: US Stock Futures Slip as Democrats Win Control of Congress
summary: U.S. stock futures fell and the dollar weakened as Democrats won control of Congress in the midterm elections, posing a blow to President Donald Trump, who threatened potential vetoes.
why: Control of the U.S. Congress determines the legislative agenda, taxation, and government spending, directly impacting fiscal policy and sector regulations across American markets.

impacts.name: US Dollar
impacts.why: Political shifts and divided government expectations weaken the dollar as uncertainty over fiscal legislation rises.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Uncertainty surrounding legislative gridlock and opposition from a newly Democratic Congress to presidential policies created mild headwinds for U.S. equity futures and the dollar.
